name: Moon phase
author: ViberDock
description: Tonight's moon as it looks, optionally with its phase name or how much of it is lit. A click shows the phase, the illumination, the moon's age and the dates of the next new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter. Computed on this PC (no internet).

settings.label: Beside the moon
settings.description: Nothing, the phase's name ("Waxing crescent") or how much of the moon is lit ("42%"). A side dock shows the moon alone when the text does not fit.

settings.label: Seen from
settings.description: The northern hemisphere sees the waxing moon lit on the right, the southern on the left.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The text's font: a font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Lit part
settings.description: The moon's sunlit part. Default: a warm white.

settings.label: Dark part
settings.description: The part in shadow. Default: a faint grey.
